requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide a programmable embedded AI workflow effect provider instead of requiring an external CLI bridge.

case.given: An AI workflow runtime context has an embedded effect provider with a registered operation handler
case.when: The workflow invokes an effect request for that operation
case.then: The provider SHALL call the registered handler with the original request and injected runtime roots

case.given: An AI workflow runtime context has no handler for an effect operation
case.then: The provider SHALL fail with a stable missing-handler error before dispatching any effect

case.given: A handler needs run identity, node identity, material refs, config and cancellation signal
case.when: The embedded provider dispatches the request
case.then: The provider SHALL pass those request fields through without deriving runtime roots from ambient process state
